content: Plugin/extension-point failure modes: breaking API changes strand the ecosystem; host invokes an extension point before plugins finish registering so behavior varies silently with startup timing; plugin leaks handles/threads across unload; leaky abstraction avalanche where each new backend needs consumer special-casing. Guidance: test-drive an abstraction with at least two concrete implementations before committing; version extension-point IDs; define stable contracts and deprecation windows.
